raw_segments.text: B. The legislative acts promulgated by the state of Massachusetts alone, from the year
1780 to the present time, already fill three stout volumes, and it must not be forgotten
that the collection to which I allude was published in 1823, when many old laws which
had fallen into disuse were omitted.
